name: aurora
description: Aurora — visual authoring (level art, sprites, animation, menus) for the Empyrean Sega Genesis suite
//overrides: electron-vite@5 (the newest stable) declares a peer of vite@^5 || ^6 || ^7, so a plain
`npm install` or `npm ci` on this repo dies with ERESOLVE against our vite@8.
This override asserts a narrow, empirical claim: THIS combination — vite 8 +
electron-vite 5 + @vitejs/plugin-react 6 — is the tree we already run. It is what
`npm run dev`, `npm run build`, `npm run preview` and `npm test` all use today, and it
passes the full vitest suite. It is NOT a claim that electron-vite 5 is compatible with
vite 8 in general; only that nothing Aurora exercises is broken by the gap.
REMOVAL CONDITION: electron-vite 6 (currently 6.0.0-beta.1) widens the peer to include
^8.0.0. When electron-vite@6 ships stable, bump the dependency and DELETE this override
and this note. Recheck with: npm view electron-vite dist-tags
